name: MKI Password Policy
overview: Password rules and forced password changes for Jellyfin users.
description: Enforces password rules (length, character types, no username, common passwords) on the server for every client, with ready-made profiles. Lets an administrator require a new password from all users or from single users: they cannot sign in on any device until they have set one. Optional password expiry and a forced change for new users. The web client shows the rules live and a change dialog; TV and native apps use a change page that opens in any browser.
changelog: Disabled users can get profiles and password requests, also from the buttons for many users; they apply once the account is enabled again. With exempt administrators on, administrators are greyed out in the list. Each user's Password tab in the dashboard now shows their profile, password status and any request, with a shortcut to them in the plugin settings. Live hints on that tab now use the rules of the user being edited.
